_note: Each cue starts 0.2s before the caption beat it describes, so the words land on the thing being shown. Beat times come from dump-schedule.mjs.

desktop.text: MediVault. Every prescription, lab report and bill your family has been handed — in one place, read and searchable.
Adding a page is one sheet. The date and the doctor are optional — it reads them off the photo.
A vision model reads the page; a language model gives it structure.
It comes back a record: doctor, hospital, diagnosis.
And every medicine, with its dose and schedule.
Everything from one visit stays together. The whole history, newest first.
One account holds the family. Each person keeps their own timeline, never under the wrong name.
Find any of it by doctor, medicine, diagnosis or year.
Including the one uploaded a minute ago.
And a page it cannot read says so, and keeps your original.
MediVault. The same app on a phone and on a desktop.
